**

Nomads Mongolian Cuisine in Innsbruck

** Discover the flavors of the steppes right in the heart of the **Alps**! At **Nomads Mongolische Küche** in **Innsbruck**, we bring you the authentic taste of **Mongolia**—spiced up with a touch of **Tirol**’s charm. Indulge in hearty dishes like **Khuushuur** (Mongolian dumplings), **Boodog** (slow-cooked lamb), and **Suutei Tsai** (Mongolian milk tea). Pair your meal with a glass of **Airag** (fermented mare’s milk) or a local **Tiroler Bier** for the perfect blend of tradition and mountain spirit. Whether you’re craving a quick snack or a full feast, our cozy **Nomads** invites you to embark on a culinary journey across the **Gobi Desert**—without leaving **Innsbruck**! **

Come taste the wild side of **Mongolia**—where every bite tells a story.

** **Visit us today!**
